clips.title: The story
paras: The Warsong Axe Shipment is a heavy crate of newly forged axes waiting on the docks of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Ordered by the Warsong Outriders to sustain their harvesting operations in Ashenvale, it serves as a crucial link in the Horde's overseas supply chain.

Maintaining the logging operations at the Warsong Lumber Camp requires a continuous flow of durable tools that cannot always be forged on the front lines. To keep woodcutters supplied, orders are sent across the Great Sea to the neutral goblin port of Booty Bay. Stored near Wharfmaster Lozgil, this crate contains sharpened axes intended for shipment back to Splintertree Post, highlighting the logistical hurdles the Horde faces in keeping its distant frontier camps armed and functional.
